def factor_range_vol_of_vol_compressed(df):
    df_copy = df.copy()
    range_ = df_copy["high"] - df_copy["low"]
    mean_range = range_.rolling(60, min_periods=20).mean()
    std_range = range_.rolling(20, min_periods=10).std(ddof=1)
    cv = std_range / mean_range.replace(0.0, np.nan)
    factor = np.sign(-cv) * np.sqrt(np.abs(-cv))
    df_copy["factor_range_vol_of_vol_compressed"] = factor
    return df_copy["factor_range_vol_of_vol_compressed"]
description: Preserves the primary range vol-of-vol mean-reversion mechanism from range_vol_vol_of_vol_mean_reversion: high volatility of daily range relative to its trailing average indicates unstable price formation and predicts lower forward returns. Borrows the signed square-root compression from factor_overnight_intraday_asymmetry as the single lightweight modifier to damp extreme vol-of-vol spikes, reducing outlier influence and targeting improved top-quantile payoff thickness while retaining the monotonic ranking and RankICIR stability of the raw signal.
